title: A companion quest (Two Keepers, One Covenant) can trigger asking the player to carry a question to an NPC (Keeper Rowan) already fully talked-to and left behind hours of play earlier, with no way to complete it short of a very long backtrack — and no warning that crossing the Pass Gate into Marrowgate permanently forfeits it.
